tagline: STIHL equipment and service for Tauranga
heroSubheading: We provide STIHL equipment, servicing, and parts for Tauranga contractors and homeowners.
aboutHtml:
We're the STIHL shop in Tauranga. Greg and Mike McLarnon run it, stocking new STIHL equipment, spare parts, and practical advice for whatever you're tackling outside. From chainsaws to hedge trimmers to mowers, we've got what you need and we know how it works.

We sell, service, and supply parts for STIHL equipment. If something's broken or worn out, bring it in and we'll repair it here. Not sure what gear to get for the job. We'll help you pick the right tool and answer your questions. Contractors, farmers, and homeowners come to us because we understand the work and we're ready to help.

Come in and say hello. We're open weekdays 8am to 5pm and Saturday mornings 9am to 12.30pm.
servicesIntro: We service STIHL equipment on site and keep spare parts ready.
